scope: Initial M05 image-import slice: reusable validated definitions, relative/unicode/long paths, background system WIC CPU decode, SHA-256, bounded cache/read/pixel capacities, cooperative cancellation, EXIF orientation, source fit, relink/missing-file/undo and granted OSC. Includes all prior source/graph/window/compositor/mapping/browser-loss regressions. No organized catalog/browser import, full jobs/readiness, video/audio, hardware image decoding, physical scanout, deadline or milestone qualification.

borrowedRenderTarget.scope: Real background D3D11 target allocation, owner 1x1 bgfx placeholder/import/RTV binding with old scene frames continuing, resized target and unchanged-scene GPU goldens. Not complete graph/window handoff or deadline-budget qualification.

graphHandoff.scope: Real background graph textures, incremental owner bindings, canvas resize, added source/layer/changed node index, fixed native window rerouting, GPU completion and cancelled-bank cleanup. Not window replacement, mapping or deadline budgets.

liveImageHandoff.scope: Actual fixed-layout live source image copies on the native render owner, background prepared immutable generations, monotonic frame/revision/clock, freeze/unfreeze/blackout, nonblocking completion and ownership retirement. Hidden-window intermediate/offscreen captures only; no engine control integration or graph/window resource handoff.

preparation.scope: Actual owned hardware device and immutable image uploads concurrent with composition frames, live image/graph/window handoffs below. Immediate context/bgfx/DXGI/SDL remain on their owner. Readbacks only offline. No engine integration in this probe, sustained deadline budget, physical scanout or device-loss qualification.

windowHandoff.scope: Real hidden SDL/bgfx windows: add/resize/remove/reuse, frozen display carry, blackout/enable, source/graph atomic swap and partial-window cancellation. DXGI stays on owner. Intermediate captures, not physical scanout or sustained deadlines.

composition.scope: Actual GPU rasterization and offline CPU readback. Static prepared render plans, no browser/native output windows or physical scanout. Resource preparation and synchronous validation are outside frame(). Runtime graph handoff, encoded preview, deadline/performance and hardware recovery qualification remain open.

native.scope: Actual engine native owner, source-image/graph/window handoffs, projective quad/shared-chart mapping, crop/fit/fill, masks, opacity and over/add/screen blends.
